name: b6-bus-oil
note: Oil beside a bus: crude and water arrive in pipes (endless) east of a bus carrying iron, copper and coal; sinks past every lane end. The order: plastic and sulfur, both onto the bus. Tests the oil area (block or hand-piped) and two bus_in merges. Met = plastic 60+/min and sulfur 15+/min for 3 samples.

objectives.name: plastic-sulfur
objectives.goal: @{agent} crude oil and water now arrive in the pipes at [gps={crude}] and [gps={water}]. Our main bus (bus main) has iron, copper and coal on it. Build plastic and sulfur from the oil, at least 60 plastic and 15 sulfur a minute, and put both onto the bus.

score.name: taps
score.lua: local b = storage.layout and storage.layout['bus:main'] local n = 0 if b then for _, j in pairs(b.joins or {}) do if j.kind == 'tap' then n = n + 1 end end end return n
